title: incident2chaos: chaos experiments derived from real cloud incident reports
description: A command line tool that turns a post-incident report, coded under a published codebook of 13 trigger codes and 20 fault classes, into Chaos Mesh or LitmusChaos experiments marked as direct injections, approximations or not injectable. It ships with the coded corpus of 497 public cloud post-incident reports (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, GitHub, 2011 to 2026) and a coverage command that reruns the measurement of paper 1. No report text is redistributed.
